name: Studio Practice
about: A pretend set for trying the Artist Studio. Nothing here goes into the game: upload anything you like, sketches, photos, doodles, and see how the Studio handles it.
style: Any style. This set is for practice.

Orchard.world: an apple orchard at golden hour: ladders, baskets, falling leaves

Citrus.world: a mountain valley at dusk, full of paper lanterns

Tropical.world: high above the clouds, on a flying ship

milestones.title: Yuzu (Foil single)
milestones.note: One picture, from sketch to finished. We get to know each other's taste on one card.

milestones.title: Mango (Gold single)
milestones.note: One picture, from sketch to finished.

milestones.title: Plum (Signature card)
milestones.note: Two pictures, Kitten and Big Cat: the best art in the set.

milestones.title: Pip (the deck's main pictures)
milestones.note: Two pictures, Kitten and Big Cat. Signed in a corner.

milestones.title: The rest of the deck
milestones.note: A few pictures at a time; we reply to each batch.

milestones.title: Pawtraits
milestones.note: After each character's card picture is agreed, so the two match.

milestones.title: Announcement key art
milestones.note: One wide picture for the release announcement.

pictures.draw: A calm cat in a yuzu-yellow hood, lighting paper lanterns on a mountain path at dusk. Warm light on her face from the lantern in her paws.
mustKeep: a yuzu or citrus hood (the Citrus family)

pictures.draw: A swashbuckling cat in a mango hood on the deck of a flying ship, one boot on the rail, clouds rushing past. It has Zoomies, so it should feel fast.
Plum as a Kitten: a small purple cat with paint on her paws, dabbing a star onto the night sky.
mustKeep: the same character as the Big Cat

pictures.draw: Plum grown up: a tall, elegant painter cat on a rooftop, a sky full of stars she painted swirling behind her.
mustKeep: the same character as the Kitten

pictures.draw: Pip as a Kitten: a tiny cat in a red apple hood, halfway up an apple tree, very proud of itself.
Pip grown up: a confident ranger cat with a satchel of apples, keeping watch over the orchard.
mustKeep: the same character as the Kitten

pictures.draw: A round little hedgehog with apple-peel spines, curled up in a basket of apples.
A pear-shaped owl on a branch at golden hour, peering at the viewer.
A stocky badger guarding the orchard gate, arms folded, crabapples around its feet.
A gust of wind shaking a tree, apples tumbling down into waiting paws. No main character needed: the moment itself.
A paper kite shaped like a leaf, high above the orchard, its string leading down out of the picture.
A small folded paper crane, come to life, hopping between fallen leaves.
mustKeep: a paper crane (the Paper Kite makes it)

pictures.draw: Yuzu's head and shoulders, from the Foil card, looking at the viewer. Simple warm background.
mustKeep: the same character as her card

pictures.draw: Mango's head and shoulders, from the Gold card, with a pirate grin.
mustKeep: the same character as the card

pictures.draw: The set's cast together: Pip in the middle of the orchard, Yuzu's lanterns and Mango's ship in the sky behind. Leave some calm space on the left for the set's name.
